Before the digital twin, the physical on.html: Before the digital twin, the physical ones. The museum's falcon-wing towers pass thr.html: The museum's falcon-wing towers pass through the factory as thousands of unique elements. Mohamad Hashem produced the production 3D models, panel breakdowns and steel shop-drawing sheets — the geometry that lets a curved monument be cast flat, tracked, trucked and re-assembled on site. The museum opened on Saadiyat in 2025.

A mountain resort on a working tea plant.html: A mountain resort on a working tea plantation above Rize, and the whole scheme is drawn from the tea service itself. The main lodge is a teapot; every guest unit is a Turkish teacup cut in half lengthwise and laid on its side — not a barrel — its curved shell stepped along the terraced slope so each roof reads as another contour of the hillside. Developed from drone site survey through concept alternatives and eight client submissions to full presentation visuals.

A UNDP-backed regeneration of the Ottoma.html: A UNDP-backed regeneration of the Ottoman clock-tower square at the heart of Tripoli. Mohamad Hashem authored the full 3D reconstruction and every visualisation, then ran the science underneath: solar comfort, wind, shadow and pedestrian simulations that shaped where people would actually sit, walk and stay.

The model was rebuilt from drone photogr.html: The model was rebuilt from drone photogrammetry of the real district; proposals were tested against annual comfort and wind data before a single render was framed. All modeling and all renders on this page are Mohamad Hashem's.

Design decisions were argued with data —.html: Design decisions were argued with data — annual comfort zones, solstice shadows, wind velocity, pedestrian stay-places, commercial heat — down to algorithmically placed café locations scored against the comfort map. Some layers were built the slow way — walking the site, counting, measuring, then turning the field notes into diagrams; others were simulated computationally in Grasshopper with Ladybug and Honeybee.
